# Amos 1 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Amos 1 (15 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 2

---

## V.1 — "herdsmen" vs. "shepherds" vs. "a shepherd"
- **EMET:** "herdsmen" / **LOGOS:** "shepherds" / **PNEUMA:** "a shepherd"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "shepherds" — standard English rendering; preserves collective noun.

---

## V.3 — "turn it back" vs. "revoke the punishment" vs. "let them go unpunished"
- **EMET:** literal "turn it back" / **LOGOS:** "revoke the punishment" / **PNEUMA:** "let them go unpunished"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "revoke the punishment" — makes referent explicit without paraphrase.

---
*— SOPHIA*
